text: Murree Brewery Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Murree Brewery Type: Monument - Building Province: Punjab District: Rawalpindi Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1857 - 1947 CE Description: A British period brewery comprised of several buildings constructed in dressed stone blocks laid in cement and lime mortar. The buildings portray typical example of colonial architecture in the area. It has true arches extensively used in the complex. Presently, the buildings are in ruined condition and abandoned.
